The result follows by preserving the posterior mean and the N−2 nonendpoint information samples and applying Carathéodory in dimension N−1. It does not require the replacement atoms to lie on Q and does not establish continuum cardinality, grid convergence, infimum interchange, or continuum reflected-pair sufficiency.
title: Receiver cardinality on a finite posterior grid
